name: ZX_REGISTRATIONS_STG
description: This table stores tax registration details that need to be imported into tax registrations table.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch name to identify the set of records to be processed

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Party type code associated with the record such as THIRD_PARTY,etc.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for registration type. System uses this in tax registration number validation and reporting based on the type, where applicable.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Column to store tax registration number. System validates the number according to tax authority validation rules, where applicable.

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code to be used for rounding taxes of this regime. Possible values are UP, DOWN and NEAREST. Rounding rule is the method to use to round off taxes to the minimum accountable unit.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code of the tax registration record.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for party registration status. System uses tax registration status as a determining factor in tax rules.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Stores registration source code and used to distinguish between formal registration numbers from logical tax registrations. Logical tax registrations do not have a formal number assigned to it but indicate that the party is considered to meet one or more requirements for reports.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for the registration such as minimum presence or revenue threshold.

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Tax for the registration record.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the registration.

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the tax of this registration is inclusive.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Date from which the tax registration record is effective

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Date until which the  tax registration record  is effective.

columns.name: DEFAULT_REGISTRATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this is the default registration for the party. The tax registration number associated with this registration is used as the default tax registration number on all tax reports.

columns.name: LEGAL_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Location name for Location identifier for the legal registration address

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_1
columns.description: First line of location address for Location identifier for the legal registration address

columns.name: TOWN_OR_CITY
columns.description: Town or city for Location identifier for the legal registration address

columns.name: REGION_1
columns.description: County (US, UK); Province (CA) for Location identifier for the legal registration address.

columns.name: TAX_AUTHORITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of tax authority as seen in hz_parties

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description:
Gives the validation status of the record being processed:
NULL - only these records will be picked up for processing by program
0  - record picked up by concurrent program for validation
1  -all id???s validated
2  - successful record
3 - error record

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request status of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
